referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The module includes the most important materials used for production. Also included is the transport of these materials and the energy needed for production.
referenceFunction.name: Stack SOFC fuel cell 125kWe, future

technology.text: Solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) with unpressurised tubular stack design for central cogeneration use. Performance, stack lifetime and catalyst use according to expected future values for a serial product. Operation with connection to low pressure gas network. Electrical efficiency 47%, total efficiency 80%.
